name: lapel_panel_right
where: Character-right chest, upper front; diamond/rhombus shaped folded-back lapel, x~0.40-0.50, y~0.73-0.80
shape: Flat angular lapel flap with raised gold-edged rim, pointed bottom toward centre-line, sitting over the coat front.
notes: Layered under the left overlap panel at the centre; carries 1 button at its outer corner (lapel_button_right). Collar stand above it belongs to neck region.

name: lapel_panel_left
where: Character-left chest; long diagonal lapel running from collar/shoulder (x~0.56, y~0.81) down across the chest to the centre closure at y~0.64
shape: Long wide lapel/overlap flap with gold-edged rim, thick, standing slightly proud; forms the double-breasted overlap.
notes: Lies over the right lapel and the closure; its lower end merges with the coat front panel. Asymmetric versus right lapel (right is diamond, left is long).

name: lapel_trim_piping
where: Around the perimeter of both lapels and continuing down the front closure edges to the belt (y~0.64) on both sides
shape: Thin raised gold bead/strip tracing the lapel outlines and the front opening edges.
notes: One continuous strip per side; lies on top of the cloth. Could be built as a trim strip or modelled into the lapel rim.

name: lapel_button
where: One on right lapel near its outer/lower-left corner (~x0.41,y0.79); one on left lapel top (~x0.54,y0.79)
shape: Round domed brass button with raised rim.
notes: Reference shows rivets/studs on the lapels, roughly matching.

name: closure_button
where: Double-breasted pairs: row 1 y~0.72 (x~0.43 and 0.52), row 2 y~0.675 (x~0.45, 0.51), row 3 y~0.635 (x~0.44, 0.52) just above/at belt
shape: Round domed brass buttons with rim; row 3 buttons are larger and overlap the belt top.
notes: Reference shows about 2-3 pairs; count 3 pairs from sculpt. Row 3 may be 2 additional belt-level buttons that I counted in the pair.

name: button_toggle_loop
where: Small horizontal bar beside left row-2 button, ~x0.52,y0.675; and a small hem tab/flap at centre y~0.63 below the buttons
shape: Tiny horizontal tab with a vertical cross-bar, like a button tab or strap keeper.
notes: Could be a sculpt detail rather than a separate object; hem tab at centre appears as a small pointed flap.

name: coat_front_panel
where: Chest and upper torso x~0.38-0.58, y~0.64-0.80, either side of closure
shape: Main coat body panels with a vertical dark-blue surface and subtle folds.

name: inner_vest_dark
where: V opening between lapels, y~0.78-0.86, x~0.46-0.52
shape: Near-black under-layer visible below the neck/mask.
notes: Partly neck region; collar overlaps it.

name: shoulder_strap
where: Left strap: wraps over top of shoulder front-to-back at x~0.57-0.64, y~0.77-0.85; right mirrors at x~0.36-0.42
shape: Wide gold-edged curved band arching over the shoulder, thick rolled rim with a darker centre.
in_reference: differs: reference shows a rectangular plate with filigree cross/diamond ornament, sculpt shows studded band
notes: Lies on top of cap plate and over the sleeve. Studs on it listed separately.

name: shoulder_strap_stud
where: About 7 per strap along its crown (top view), graded in size, bigger near the arm-side (front) end; front end shows 3 (small, medium, large), back end 3
shape: Small domed rivets, oval where foreshortened.
notes: Count per side is 6-7; right side looks like 6.

name: shoulder_cap_plate
where: Over the deltoid, behind/outside the strap; left x~0.60-0.68, y~0.77-0.83; right mirror x~0.26-0.36
shape: Curved dome armour plate with raised gold rim along upper edge and a lower scalloped lip.
notes: Under the strap, over the sleeve. Has a semicircular outline in top view with a gold painted band.

name: shoulder_cap_stud
where: About 4 per plate in an arc across the top (top view), plus one on its outer upper face
notes: Painted gold lines across the plate in the texture are wear only.

name: shoulder_lame_flap
where: Lower outer flap hanging down the upper arm, left x~0.62-0.68, y~0.76-0.80; mirrored on right
shape: Angular overlapping lame plate with gold edging, pointed lower corner, one stud near the tip.
notes: Layered below cap plate and over sleeve.

name: shoulder_lame_stud
where: One per flap near the pointed tip
notes: May just be the same family as cap studs.

name: armhole_roll
where: Ring around the armscye under each shoulder, y~0.72-0.80
shape: Thick dark rolled bead / seam ring where the sleeve joins the coat, with a gold-edged piping on the front arc.
notes: Could be built as part of the coat; has double rings in the left/right views.

name: back_yoke_seam_ridge
where: Raised ridges running from shoulder strap base diagonally down the back to waist, x~0.43-0.55, y~0.64-0.84
shape: Narrow raised princess seams outlining the back panel.
in_reference: differs: reference shows a gold central cross and a back yoke band

name: back_panel
shape: Smooth dark-blue panel with wave-like folds.
notes: Reference has cape/yoke flap across the top and vertical centre seam.

name: back_cross_emblem
shape: Gold gothic cross/filigree running down the spine.
notes: Not in the sculpt; listed as a missing item.

name: back_yoke_cape
shape: Short flap over the upper back.
in_reference: yes, missing or only vaguely present in sculpt
notes: Sculpt has only a subtle ridge.
